build_attention_layer: build a Penzai neural network attention layer using the Attention class for transformer models
create_residual_connection: create a Residual combinator that adds the input to the output of a subnetwork block
build_linear_layer: build a Linear or Affine layer with configurable weight initializers like xavier_normal_initializer
create_embedding_lookup: create an EmbeddingLookup module that maps token IDs to dense embedding vectors
build_layer_normalization: build a LayerNorm or RMSLayerNorm standardization layer for neural network activations
